newsItems.title: Cinema and Images for Schools 2026 – Deadline extended to 25 September
newsItems.context: The deadline for submitting project proposals under the three calls of the 2026 National Plan for Cinema and Images for Schools has been extended to 25 September 2026, 3:00 p.m. (Directorial Decrees of 18 September 2026 rep. 2762, 2763 and 2764). The extension covers the call for schools and the two calls for projects of national and territorial relevance. Proposals must provide for activities to be carried out from publication of the rankings until 15 December 2027; applications are submitted through cinemaperlascuola.istruzione.it.

newsItems.title: Art-house cinemas – 2026 call for the qualification and for contributions on 2025 programming
newsItems.context: The call has been published, under Article 27 of Law 220/2016, for recognition of art-house cinema status and for contributions on the programming of art-house films or of films of research and experimentation screened in 2025, funding year 2026. Applications are submitted through the DGCOL platform within the mandatory window from 21 September 2026 to 14 October 2026, 11:59 p.m. When applying, applicants must meet the requirements of Article 2 of the call, failing which the application is inadmissible.

newsItems.title: Dissemination of film culture – 2026 call for film societies, national associations and community cinemas
newsItems.context: The call has been published for contributions to activities disseminating film culture carried out by film societies, national film culture associations and community cinemas, year 2026, under Article 27 of Law 220/2016. Applications are submitted through the DGCOL platform from 1 to 31 October 2026, 11:59 p.m.

newsItems.title: Tax credit for cinema operating costs – 2025 session opens (Directorial Decree rep. 2729)
newsItems.context: Directorial Decree of 17 September 2026 rep. 2729 opens the session for the tax credit on the operating costs of cinemas (TCF): applications are submitted through DGCOL from 12:00 noon on 21 September 2026 until 11:59 p.m. on 20 October 2026, for operating costs incurred between 1 January and 31 December 2025. The credit is granted within the annual resource ceiling set by Ministerial Decree of 6 March 2025 no. 55, applying the proportional reduction mechanism under Article 11(5) et seq. of Interministerial Decree of 4 November 2025 no. 411. Under Article 20(2) of the tax credit decree for exhibition and enhancement, the Directorate examines applications in chronological order and, having verified completeness, eligibility requirements and the actual availability of resources, grants the credit and reserves the relevant amounts: the order of submission affects the outcome.

newsItems.title: Certifications – Extended to the distribution, exhibition and enhancement tax credits (Directorial Decree rep. 2738)
newsItems.context: Directorial Decree of 17 September 2026 rep. 2738 amends Directorial Decree of 14 October 2024 no. 3361 on the requirements for certifying professionals and the content of certifications, extending it to applications for the tax credits for film and audiovisual distribution, for cinema exhibition undertakings and for the enhancement of the cinema offering, under Articles 16, 17(1) and 18 of Law 220/2016 respectively. The decree also amends the scope of the certifications required to access certain support measures. The consolidated text of Directorial Decree 3361/2024, updated with these amendments, has also been published.

newsItems.title: Administrative fees – New tables for the distribution, exhibition and enhancement tax credits (Directorial Decree rep. 2739)
newsItems.context: Directorial Decree of 17 September 2026 rep. 2739 amends Directorial Decree of 14 October 2024 no. 3362 on payment of the contribution towards administrative processing fees, introducing the tables of fees due for applications relating to the tax credits under Articles 16, 17(1) and 18 of Law 220/2016, applicable from the sessions concerning 2025 onwards: Table 1.B for distribution undertakings, 1.C for exhibition undertakings and 1.D for the enhancement of the cinema offering. Note that the consolidated text of Directorial Decree 3362/2024 published alongside the notice states on its cover page that it incorporates amendments only up to Directorial Decree 4244/2025 and does not contain the three new tables: fees on these lines must therefore be calculated from the text of Directorial Decree 2739 (checked on 20 September 2026).

newsItems.title: Promotion 2025 – Rankings for contributions to the dissemination of film culture (Directorial Decree rep. 2742)
newsItems.context: Directorial Decree of 17 September 2026 no. 2742 and the rankings for the award of contributions to activities disseminating film culture carried out by national film culture associations, film societies and community cinemas within cinema exhibition for the year 2025 have been published, under the call of 30 December 2025 decr. 4323 (Article 27 of Law 220/2016). The awards are set out in three annexes, covering national associations, community cinemas and film societies respectively.

newsItems.title: Automatic contributions – New ministerial decree (D.M. 18 June 2026 rep. 265)
newsItems.context: Ministerial Decree of 18 June 2026 rep. 265 has been published, laying down the implementing rules for automatic contributions under Articles 23, 24 and 25 of Law 220/2016; it repeals and replaces Ministerial Decree of 15 July 2021 rep. 251. The new decree applies to applications for the 2026 funding year (results achieved in 2025); for the 2022–2025 funding years Ministerial Decree 251/2021 continues to apply, together with certain provisions of the new decree, including the obligation to document results on pain of inadmissibility and forfeiture of the benefit if the work does not obtain final Italian nationality. Notable provisions include fully paid-up share capital and net equity of at least EUR 40,000 (EUR 10,000 for short films), and use of the amounts in the company's potential fund by 31 December of the fifth year after they are credited, on pain of forfeiture. Within thirty days of publication the Directorate will adopt the implementing directorial decrees and publish the new application forms.

newsItems.title: Special projects 2026 – Application deadline extended to 14 September
newsItems.context: Directorial Decree of 4 September 2026 rep. 2623 extends the deadline for submitting applications under the "Call for contributions to special projects for cinema and audiovisual works – Year 2026", issued by Directorial Decree of 24 July 2026 no. 2366, to 23:59 on Monday 14 September 2026.

newsItems.title: Video games – Final Italian nationality granted (D.D. rep. 2595)
newsItems.context: Directorial Decree of 31 August 2026 rep. 2595 publishes the list of video game works granted final Italian nationality. The publication itself constitutes notice of recognition of nationality: no individual notifications will be sent by certified email (PEC). The decree does not cover works whose assessment is still being finalised, which will be included in subsequent directorial decrees published in the same manner. The list is also available under 'Administrative activities – Italian nationality of works' on the institutional website.

newsItems.title: Video game tax credit – Final claims approved (D.D. rep. 2594)
newsItems.context: Directorial Decree of 31 August 2026 rep. 2594 publishes the outcome of the eligibility assessment of the final (balance) tax credit claims submitted for the production of video games of Italian nationality. The publication constitutes notice of recognition of the tax credit and is not followed by individual notifications by certified email (PEC). Claims whose assessment is still being finalised are excluded and will be covered by subsequent directorial decrees. The decree lists the beneficiaries and their final tax credits.

newsItems.title: Cinema exhibition tax credit – Decrees on operating costs and investments (rep. 2591 and 2593)
newsItems.context: The directorial decrees of 31 August 2026 rep. 2591 (tax credit for cinema operating costs) and rep. 2593 (tax credit for investments in cinemas) publish the outcome of the eligibility assessments of the tax credit claims relating to operating costs and to investments in cinemas. The publication constitutes notice of recognition of the tax credit, with no individual notices sent by certified email (PEC). The credit may be used from the 10th day of the month following the notice of recognition, pursuant to Art. 3 of the 'Ministerial Decree on other tax credits 2021' as amended. The decrees do not include claims already recognised previously, nor those whose assessment is still being finalised.

newsItems.title: Production and distribution tax credit – Recognitions, eligibility and cultural eligibility (rep. 2588-2592)
newsItems.context: The directorial decrees of 31 August 2026 publish the outcome of the eligibility assessments of: preliminary tax credit claims for film, TV/web, short film and documentary production (rep. 2592); final claims for film and TV/web production, short films, documentaries, executive production of foreign works and national distribution (rep. 2590); and claims for tax credit eligibility (rep. 2589) and cultural eligibility (rep. 2588). The publication constitutes notice of recognition of the tax credit and is not followed by individual certified emails (PEC). The credit may be used from the 10th day of the month following the notice, pursuant to Art. 6 of the 'Ministerial Decree on production tax credit 2021' and Art. 3 of the 'Ministerial Decree on other tax credits 2021' as amended, or from the 15th day pursuant to Art. 34(1) of the 'Ministerial Decree on production tax credit 2024' and Art. 14(1) of the 'Ministerial Decree on international tax credit 2024'.

newsItems.title: Cinema upgrade plan 2024 – Final (balance) applications open
newsItems.context: From 12:00 on Monday 24 August 2026 applicants may submit the final (balance) application for the Plan to upgrade the network of cinemas and multi-purpose venues – 2024 funding year. Before submitting, the Directorate recommends checking the provisions of the Call for the upgrade of cinemas and multi-purpose venues of 7 August 2025. The notice is accompanied by a document of FAQs and interpretative clarifications on the 2024 final applications, and by a user guide to the online platform.

newsItems.title: Minority co-productions 2025 – Complete ranking published
newsItems.context: Directorial Decree of 10 August 2026 rep. 2537 publishes the decree and the complete ranking of the projects submitted under the 2025 call for selective contributions to feature films made as minority international co-productions or co-financings. The document is also available in the 'Assigned contributions' section. For the payment procedure, including the guidelines on how to request the advance payment, refer to the call and to the dedicated vademecum.

newsItems.title: DIAC logo – New display obligation for funded works
newsItems.context: Except for productions already completed, future works benefiting from a contribution or tax credit must display the logo of the Department for Cultural Activities (DiAC) alongside that of the Directorate-General for Cinema and Audiovisual. The obligation extends to all communication materials for initiatives promoted by the Directorate and for funded activities, in print, digital and audiovisual formats, and also applies to contribution beneficiaries and to partners of co-financed initiatives; for film and audiovisual works the logo must also appear in the end credits. The logo is available on request under the same terms as the DGCA logo; further operational guidance will follow.

newsItems.title: Minority co-productions 2026 – Call published, EUR 5 million budget
newsItems.context: The call for selective contributions to feature films made as minority international co-productions or co-financings – Year 2026 has been published, with an annual budget of EUR 5 million supporting the production of feature-length films. Two sessions are scheduled: the first from 1 September to 28 September 2026 (23:59), the second from 30 November to 18 December 2026 (23:59). Applications must be submitted exclusively through DGCOL: applicants must complete or update both the entity and the work registration and request provisional Italian nationality as an international co-production or co-financing before submitting the contribution application.

newsItems.title: Selective contributions 2025, writing – second session ranking published
newsItems.context: Directorial Decree of 31 July 2026 rep. 2504 publishes the complete rankings of the projects applying for selective contributions (Art. 26 of Law 220/2016) in the second 2025 session of the call for the writing, development and production of film and audiovisual works, for the writing strand. The documents are available in the 'Assigned incentives' section.

newsItems.title: Selective contributions 2025, development – second session ranking published
newsItems.context: Directorial Decree of 31 July 2026 rep. 2503 publishes the complete rankings of the projects applying for selective contributions (Art. 26 of Law 220/2016) in the second 2025 session of the call for the writing, development and production of film and audiovisual works, for the development strand. The documents are available in the 'Assigned incentives' section.

newsItems.title: Automatic contributions – Reinvestment authorised
newsItems.context: Directorial Decree of 31 July 2026 rep. 2497 authorising the reinvestment of automatic contributions has been published.

newsItems.title: Tax credit – Decrees of 30 July 2026 granting tax credits and cultural eligibility
newsItems.context: Directorial Decrees of 30 July 2026 rep. 2476 (final claims), 2475 (provisional claims), 2472 (tax credit suitability), 2470 (cultural eligibility) and 2468 (cultural eligibility for the reinvestment of automatic contributions) publish the outcomes of the assessments on the admissibility of provisional and final tax credit claims for film and tv/web production, research and training works, documentaries, animation, executive production of foreign works and national and international distribution. Publication constitutes formal notice that the tax credit has been granted: no individual notices will be sent by certified email. The credit may be used from the 10th day of the month following the notice (Art. 6 of the 2021 Production Tax Credit Ministerial Decree and Art. 3 of the 2021 Other Tax Credits Ministerial Decree, as amended) or from the 15th day (Art. 34(1) of the 2024 Production Tax Credit Decree and Art. 14(1) of the 2024 International Tax Credit Decree).

newsItems.title: Tax credit for enhancing cinema exhibition – Decree of 30 July 2026
newsItems.context: Directorial Decree of 30 July 2026 rep. 2473 publishes the outcomes of the assessments on the admissibility of tax credit claims relating to cinema operating costs. Publication constitutes formal notice that the tax credit has been granted and no individual notices will be sent by certified email. The credit may be used from the 10th day of the month following the notice, pursuant to Art. 3 of the 2021 Other Tax Credits Ministerial Decree, as amended.

newsItems.title: Video game tax credit – Final tax credit claims approved
newsItems.context: Directorial Decree of 30 July 2026 rep. 2462 publishes the outcome of the assessment on the admissibility of final tax credit claims for the production of video games of Italian nationality. Publication constitutes formal notice that the tax credit has been granted and no individual notices will be sent by certified email; claims still under assessment will be covered by subsequent decrees.

newsItems.title: Italian nationality for video games – Provisional and final decrees of 30 July 2026
newsItems.context: Directorial Decree of 30 July 2026 rep. 2464 ('provisional Italian nationality for video games') and Directorial Decree of 30 July 2026 rep. 2463 ('final Italian nationality for video games') have been published. Publication constitutes formal notice that Italian nationality has been recognised and no individual notices will be sent by certified email. The lists are also available under 'Administrative activities – Italian nationality of works' on the institutional website.

newsItems.title: Special Projects 2026 – Call for contributions published
newsItems.context: The call for contributions to special cinema and audiovisual projects (Art. 27(1) of Law 220/2016) has been published. Applications must be submitted exclusively through DGCOL from 31 July 2026 (12:00) to 4 September 2026 (23:59). The full text of the call is attached to the notice and available in the 'Cinema Law calls' section.

newsItems.title: Impact assessment call 2026 – Ranking approved and contribution awarded
newsItems.context: Directorial Decree rep. 2268 of 20 July 2026 approves the ranking and the award of the contribution for activities assessing the economic, industrial and employment impact of the measures under Law 220/2016. The call had been published by notice of 24 April 2026 no. 20500.

newsItems.title: Italy-France 2026 call, first session – Outcome and complete ranking
newsItems.context: Directorial Decree rep. 2254 of 17 July 2026 publishes the outcome and the complete ranking of the first 2026 session of the call for the development and production of Italian-French co-productions. From 27 July 2026 beneficiaries may upload the documentation for advance-payment requests, following the guidelines attached to the notice.

newsItems.title: Special Projects 2025 – Complete ranking of promotion projects
newsItems.context: Directorial Decree rep. 2252 of 17 July 2026 publishes the award decree and the complete ranking of the 2025 special promotion projects (Art. 27 of Law 220/2016). The decree and the ranking are also available in the 'Assigned incentives – Promotion' section.

newsItems.title: Expert Commissions under Art. 26 and Art. 27 of Law 220/2016 – Calls for the appointment of members
newsItems.context: Four notices have been published for the appointment of the expert commissions under Art. 26(2) and Art. 27(2-bis) of Law 220/2016: for each commission, an individual expression of interest and a notice reserved to the most representative industry associations. Requirements: at least five years' experience in the sector (production, distribution, exhibition, programming, festivals) or at least ten years for critics, legal experts and university professors. Applications by 27 July 2026 (23:59) via certified email to dg-ca.servizio2@pec.cultura.gov.it (Art. 26) and dg-ca.servizio4@pec.cultura.gov.it (Art. 27), with Annex A, curriculum vitae and identity document.

newsItems.title: Art-house films (film d'essai) – 15 July 2026 decision recognising the qualification
newsItems.context: The decision of 15 July 2026 has been published, by which the expert commission (Art. 26(2) of Law 220/2016) recognises the art-house film qualification pursuant to Art. 2 of the Ministerial Decree of 14 July 2017 as amended. The list of works is available in the 'Administrative activities – Recognition of art-house film status' section.

newsItems.title: Selective contributions 2025 – Complete rankings for the second session published (Production)
newsItems.context: Directorial decrees rep. 2211, 2212 and 2213 of 10 July 2026 publish the complete rankings for the 2025 second session for production: cinematographic works (feature films by young authors, first and second works, documentaries, short films, animation), films of particular artistic quality and Italian cultural identity, and TV and web works on national cultural identity. The decrees and project lists are available in the 'Assigned incentives' section.

newsItems.title: Selective contributions 2024 – Complete rankings for TV and web works on 'Italian identity' (Sessions I and II)
newsItems.context: Directorial decree rep. 2214 of 10 July 2026 publishes the complete rankings of production projects for TV and web works dedicated to figures and events of Italian national cultural identity (Art. 26 of Law 220/2016), for the first and second 2024 sessions. The decree and attached lists are available on the official notice page.

newsItems.title: National Plan 'Cinema and Images for School' 2026 – Calls published
newsItems.context: The Ministry of Culture and the Ministry of Education and Merit publish the three 2026 calls (Action B.1 national relevance, Action B.2 territorial relevance and cinematic language), with €20.1M total. Platform open from 13 July (3:00 pm) to 18 September 2026 (3:00 pm) on cinemaperlascuola.istruzione.it.

newsItems.title: Videogames Tax Credit – 30 June 2026 Decree approving final applications
newsItems.context: Directorial Decree rep. 2012: the outcome on final tax credit applications for the production of videogames of Italian nationality is published. Online publication counts as recognition; no individual PEC notification will be sent.

newsItems.title: Provisional and Final Italian Nationality for Videogames – 30 June 2026 Decrees
newsItems.context: Directorial Decrees rep. 2014 and 2015: recognition of provisional and final Italian nationality for videogame works. Online publication is the official notification; lists are available in the 'Italian nationality of works' section.

newsItems.title: Selective Contributions – Opening of 2025 advance-payment requests (Production, Development, Screenwriting)
newsItems.context: Advance-payment requests (50%) are open for winning projects of the 2025 Session I. Screenwriting and development: within 90 days of the award resolution, deadline 18 August 2026. Production: within 12 months of the ranking decree. Submission via DGCOL with DURC and, above €150,000, anti-mafia documentation.

newsItems.title: Payments – Cinema and multipurpose venues enhancement plan – DM 190/2025
newsItems.context: From 15 June 2026 beneficiaries (intervention Line D) may request the 30% advance of the assigned grant, filing via PEC with proof of works commencement and a substitute declaration under DPR 445/2000.

newsItems.title: Videogames Tax Credit – 2025 preliminary applications session open (10 June 2026)
newsItems.context: Directorial Decree rep. 1657: terms and procedures for preliminary tax credit applications for videogame production. Submission window on DGCOL from 19 June (10:00) to 20 August 2026 (23:59).

newsItems.title: FAQ – 2026 Selective Grants call: access requirements
newsItems.context: FAQ published on the access requirements for the 2026 selective contributions call, in particular the obligation to have produced/distributed at least one audiovisual work in the last 5 years.

newsItems.title: Cinema venues enhancement plan 2024 – Line D (4 June 2026)
newsItems.context: Directorial Decree rep. 1491 publishes grants for the structural and technological renovation and upgrade of cinema venues (intervention Line D), for cinema operators.

articles.title: Tax Credit for Cinematographic and Audiovisual Production
articles.summary: Tax credit on eligible expenditure for Italian nationality works or co-productions: 40% for films by independent producers, 25% raised to 35% for TV and web works. Total public support may not exceed 50% of the cost of the work.
keyPoints: Films 40% for independent producers, TV and web works 25% raised to 35%
Mandatory cultural eligibility requirement
Eligible costs: personnel, services, post-production in Italy
Preliminary and final applications via DGCOL platform
Legal basis art. 15 Law 220/2016 and Interministerial Decree MiC-MEF 10 July 2024 rep. 225, as amended by Decree 22 April 2025 rep. 141
Total public support may not exceed 50% of the cost of the work

articles.title: Tax Credit for Videogame Production (2026)
articles.summary: Dedicated incentive for Italian-nationality videogame works. Specific procedures, dedicated nationality test and recognition on development/production expenditure incurred in Italy.
keyPoints: Final recognition on admitted applications (D.D. 29/5 rep. 1479)
Separate final Italian nationality decree (D.D. rep. 1480)
Eligible costs: development, Italian team, local services
Applications via DGCOL; final (consuntivo) investigation
articles.errorsToAvoid: Failure to separate core costs from marketing/publishing; insufficient Italian IP for the nationality test.

articles.title: Tax Credit for Attracting Foreign Investment
articles.summary: The beneficiary is the Italian executive production or post-production company working on commission, not the foreign client. A credit of 40% of the eligible cost incurred in Italy, within the 50% ceiling on total public support.
keyPoints: 40% of the eligible cost, provided it is at least 250,000 euro
The Italian company must not hold any share of the rights in the work, save express derogation
Sessions opened each year by directorial decree: the 2026 one closed on 31 August
Total public support may not exceed 50% of the cost of the work

articles.title: Selective Contributions for Screenwriting, Development and Production
articles.summary: Annual calls under Art. 26 of Law 220/2016. Non-repayable grants for artistically and culturally valuable projects. Separate sessions for writing, development and production.
keyPoints: 2026 allocations: €1M writing, €2M development, >€32.7M production
Reserved quotas for young authors, documentaries, animation, cultural identity
Assessment based on artistic quality, feasibility and distribution plan
Implementing rules: Min. Decree 8 October 2024 rep. 345 (art. 26 Law 220/2016)
Aid intensity limits: 50% of the cost of the work in production, 80% in development

articles.title: Selective Contributions, assessment and payment
articles.summary: How the Committee assesses projects, how long the rankings take, when the advance and the balance are paid, and when a grant can be revoked.
keyPoints: Ninety days to request the 50% advance, paid within 30 days of the request
Sixty days for administrative checks and sixty for the Committee's assessment
Anti-mafia check above 150,000 euro and verification of social security compliance
In screenwriting, revocation can also concern the merit of the work

articles.title: International Co-productions and Bilateral Agreements
articles.summary: Agreements with France and other countries for co-development and co-production. Access to cross-funding and multi-nationality recognition.
keyPoints: Active Italy-France 2026 call with dedicated sessions
Points for minority and majority co-productions
Integration with Creative Europe MEDIA programmes

articles.title: DGCOL Platform: how to submit Tax Credit and contribution applications
articles.summary: Practical guide to completing and submitting preliminary/final applications on the MiC DGCOL platform. Documentary requirements and timing.
keyPoints: Access via SPID/CIE for the legal representative
Upload contracts, budget, production plan, materials
Peremptory deadlines: preliminary before significant qualified expenditure
All communications and integrations handled online
articles.errorsToAvoid: Uploading non-compliant files or failing to list all 'qualified' expenditure on Italian territory.

articles.title: Common errors in cultural eligibility and nationality (2026)
articles.summary: Summary of the most frequent reasons for rejection or requests for integration in the 2026 decrees, with practical suggestions based on practice.
keyPoints: Insufficient score in the cultural test (table annexed to the DM)
Failure to demonstrate prevailing Italian creative contribution
Incomplete or outdated IP/authorship documentation
Budget and distribution plan inconsistent with the declared work
articles.errorsToAvoid: Underestimating the 'Italian cultural identity' or 'artistic quality' component for reserved quotas.

articles.title: Cumulability of Tax Credit, selective contributions and regional incentives
articles.summary: Cumulation rules between national measures, bilateral agreements, Creative Europe MEDIA and regional film commissions. The constraint governing all of them is the 50% ceiling on public support for the cost of the work.
keyPoints: Cumulation is possible, but total public support may not exceed 50% of the cost of the work
Regional funds and film commission grants also fall within that limit
Attention to 'State aid' rules and ceilings per undertaking/production unit
Separate reporting obligation for each measure
articles.errorsToAvoid: Declaring the same expenditure under multiple measures without authorisation or double counting in reporting.

articles.title: Tax credit, what is in force and what is changing (2026)
articles.summary: The rules in force are Interministerial Decree MiC-MEF 225/2024, as amended by corrective Decree 141/2025. A new decree lowering maximum rates and per-work credit limits and introducing per-company caps was signed by the Minister of Culture on 18 June 2026, but as of September 2026 it had not been published and has no effect until it is. On 10 September 2026 the Chamber of Deputies approved at first reading the consolidated film law, now before the Senate.
keyPoints: Rules in force are Interministerial Decree MiC-MEF 10 July 2024 rep. 225, as amended by Decree 22 April 2025 rep. 141
The new decree lowers maximum rates and introduces per-company caps, but does not apply until published
The consolidated law approved by the Chamber reorganises the tax credit and creates an Agency for film and audiovisual
Before closing a financing plan, check whether the new decree has been published
